title: Bahama Breeze
meta_description: Beachfront condo at Emerald Isle with gulf views, balcony, pools, hot tub \& direct beach access---your perfect Panama City Beach escape!
description_expanded:
\*\*\* West End - Gulf Front Condo -- 21st Floor
\*\*\* 2 Community Pools (1 heated seasonally)

ABOUT THE HOME: This lovely beach front condo is conveniently located in the beaches "Best Kept Secret" Resort, Emerald Isle, which is also rated the #1 Specialty Resort on Panama City Beach. This unit is on the West end of the building which provides you with the most amazing views from the private balcony. It's perfect for entertaining and enjoying the sunset. The living room includes a large flat screen TV for the games or an evening movie, which you can enjoy from the comfortable sleeper sofa or 2 sitting chairs. Also in this unit is a king size bed in the master bedroom with more views of the gulf and access to the private balcony and a queen bed in the guest bedroom. The kitchen comes fully equipped with dishes and cookware for cooking a family meal or to just enjoy a snack when taking a break from the beach. The dining table comfortably seats 4 and the kitchen bar has stools for the overflow of family.

ABOUT THE AREA: Onsite are two pools: one that is heated and both are located on the gulf side on the ground floor in addition to a large hot tub. The property also features an exercise room, sauna, and steam room. You can also find an onsite pavilion with BBQ grills. Whether it's strolling on the beach, snorkeling, parasailing, or fishing, close by you'll find opportunities to enjoy everything there is to do in, under, above, or on the water.

BEACH ACCESS: Head to the ground floor to access the beautiful emerald coast.

Immerse yourself in the vibrant charm of Emerald Isle Resort in PCB!
Secure your spot for the ultimate beach getaway at Emerald Isle, nestled along the pristine white shores of Northwest Florida, promising a delightful Southern experience. Enhance your stay with the numerous community amenities that Emerald Isle has to offer. Answer the call of the beautiful beach view and venture downstairs to discover two Gulf-front pools for blissful lounging, a hot tub to soak away stress, and an on-site fitness room for those seeking an invigorating workout. Unite with fellow guests at the pool pavilion, where you can showcase your culinary skills on two stainless steel grills for a delightful cookout.
Don't forget to venture out and explore the nearby attractions during your stay in Panama City Beach. With a prime location along the shore, you're just moments away from exciting activities, including the renowned Gulf World Marine Park. Pier Park, the area's premier shopping, dining, and entertainment center, is also conveniently nearby. Countless opportunities for fun await throughout Panama City Beach, ensuring your stay at Emerald Isle is filled with joyful and unforgettable moments.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 -- King Master with Ensuite
• Bedroom 2 -- Queen Bed
• Queen Sleeper Sofa in living room

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• 1 Assigned Reserved parking spot (HOA fee applies)
• Ocean front
• Private balcony with outdoor seating
• 2 Community Pools (1 heated)
• Community Hot Tub
• Gym/Fitness Center with sauna and steam room
• Onsite Pavilion with BBQ grills
• Washer \& Dryer in unit
• Fully equipped kitchen
• Self-Check-In
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath towels, wash clothes

Enjoy an exclusive invitation with your booking to seasonal bonfires on the beach! Book your stay today!

\*\*HOA REQUIRED FEE: Upon arrival parking and pool passes must be purchased at the main office located on the 4th floor and must be displayed at all times. Passes are $40 per space for the duration of your stay.\*\*

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: Pier Park,The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Guests must be 25 years or older to book this home.

Parking Details:
- This unit comes with 1 assigned reserved parking spot in the secure covered parking garage. There is overflow parking across the street, with a covered walkway to the 3rd floor. (HOA fee applies)

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
